entities.summary: Callan Hayden Foote is an American-born Canadian professional ice hockey defenceman for the Chicago Wolves of the American Hockey League (AHL). Foote was selected 14th overall in the 2017 NHL entry draft by the Tampa Bay Lightning. Foote won the Stanley Cup with the Lightning in 2021.
